newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania 1996 GDP seen at possible four pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania 1996 GDP seen at possible four pct.

text.p: Lithuania's gross domestic product is expected to have registered around four percent growth last year, the statistics department said.
Preliminary 1996 GDP figures are expected at the end of this month, statistics department executive head Petras Adlys told a news conference on Saturday, which was a working day in Lithuania.
"The country's GDP growth in the third quarter of 1996 was 3.6 percent and we expect the figure might be up to 4 percent at the end of the year," Adlys said.
Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius has earlier predicted that GDP growth in 1997 could be as high as five percent.
